notes: Burn It Out removes Regurgitate from the Demon Hunter; Vengeful Retreat removes Paralyzing Shots and other effects only when their movement component is classified as a snare.
Chaos Nova resets susceptible Ravenous Claws stacks. Imprison is creature-type-limited and is a control stop, not a school lockout.
Vengeful Retreat clears Spore Spines from the Demon Hunter but does not remove Bloodthorn Roots.
Chaos Nova, Imprison, or Sigil of Misery can stop susceptible Thornclaw Leap casts.
Consume Magic removes Healing Breeze if its cast completes; Soul Cleanse removes the listed curse from the Demon Hunter.
Vengeful Retreat clears Frigid Roar from the Demon Hunter; interrupting it remains preferable.
Consume Magic removes Fel Crazed and Soul Cleanse removes Curse of Doom only from the Demon Hunter.
Spectral Sight reveals Street Sneaks; Imprison and area control provide creature-dependent stops.
Vengeful Retreat clears Gravitic Orbs slow stacks and Violent Sand from the Demon Hunter; it must not be used into unsafe positioning.
Chaos Nova or Sigil of Misery breaks A Knot of Snakes when the targets are susceptible; a pre-placed Sigil can free the Demon Hunter.
Consume Magic removes Bound by Shadow, Captain's Bulwark, or Unholy Mending. Burn It Out and Soul Cleanse are self-only answers to Wretched Discharge and Hex effects.
Vengeful Retreat clears eligible Serpent Strike, Frost Shock, or Shadowfrost Bolt snares, not arbitrary debuffs.
Consume Magic removes Blaze of Glory and Stormcloud Barrier; Vengeful Retreat clears eligible Cold Claws snares from the Demon Hunter.

recommendations: Disrupt, Chaos Nova, and Sigil of Misery handle separate or clustered orbs; Consume Magic can clean up a missed orb.
No dedicated utility swap is required; focus the emissary and align available burst.
Use Demon Hunter mobility to intercept a partner's orb; no dedicated utility talent is required.
Vengeful Retreat removes the personal slow; Burn It Out or Soul Cleanse lets Immolation Aura remove an eligible self shield.

provenance.description: Original structured transcription of Shadarek's Patch 12.1.0 Havoc dungeon and affix guidance; placeholders and talent strings are excluded.
